statements.text: Copper and plastic are the materials that make up this wire.
Electricity itself is a material the wire is made from.
Only the plastic coating counts as a material; the copper core does not.

stem: Charu looks at an electrical wire: a copper metal core with a plastic coating around it. She wants to name the materials the wire is made from.

teacher.key_rationale: Materials are the substances an object is made from. This wire is copper and plastic. Electricity is not a material of the wire, and both parts count.
